Daily 10 · Decadence Inc.

Daily 10 Account & Data Deletion

Last updated: 29 October 2026
Android app: com.decadencearcade.daily10

You can contact the Daily 10 developer to request account and associated data deletion without installing or opening the app.

Delete your account in the app

Open Settings → Account → Delete account in Daily 10. Review the explanation, verify your identity if requested, and confirm deletion. Signing out or uninstalling alone does not request deletion of your Daily 10 account.

Request account deletion

  1. Email farz@decadenceinc.com with the subject Daily 10 account deletion.
  2. If you have a Daily 10 account, send the request from the email associated with it. Tell us that you want your Daily 10 account and associated data deleted.
  3. If you cannot access that email, explain this in your message. We will contact you to establish account ownership before deleting account data.

Email a deletion request

This button opens your email app; you must send the message to submit the request. If it does not open, copy the address above into your preferred email service. Do not send passwords, sign-in codes, purchase tokens, payment-card details, or quiz-backup files.

What is deleted

  • Your Daily 10 sign-in identity and associated account profile, including stored email address, display name, and account identifier.
  • Developer-held membership records, purchase-verification references, and the association between your Daily 10 account and lifetime access.
  • Daily 10's app-managed quiz backups in your connected Google Drive, while access to those files is authorized.

Deletion stops account synchronization and invalidates Daily 10 account sessions. Quiz answers and history are kept on your device and, when enabled, in your Google Drive backup; they are not stored in the developer's membership database.

If Google Drive access has been revoked or the backup cannot be reached, we will explain how to remove the remaining Daily 10 backup through Google Drive. This does not prevent deletion of the account information held by the developer.

Timing and retained information

We complete deletion of developer-held account data within 30 days after verifying account ownership, and send confirmation when it is complete. If further verification is needed, we will explain what is required. We do not ask for your Google password or sign-in codes.

Deleted account information is removed from active systems. Any remaining copies in service recovery backups expire within 90 days after active-system deletion and are not used to restore a deleted account. We do not retain your account profile or purchase-verification references for marketing or analytics.

Deletion-request correspondence, including the email address you used, may be kept for up to 90 days after the request is closed to handle follow-up questions and document its resolution, then deleted.

Remove progress saved on your phone

Open Android Settings, find Daily 10 under Apps, open its storage settings, and choose Clear storage or Clear data. The exact labels vary by device. This removes local quiz history and preferences and cannot be undone unless you have a separate backup. Uninstalling the app also removes its local app data.

Manual JSON exports and Android system backups are separate copies. Delete exported files from the storage locations you selected, and manage system backups using your device or backup provider. Restoring a backup may restore previously saved progress. An email request cannot remotely erase files stored only on your phone or in your own backup storage.

Google accounts and Google Play

A Daily 10 account-deletion request does not delete your Google account or Google's own transaction records. It does not request a Google Play refund. Account-bound access is removed with the Daily 10 account. If you later return, lifetime access must be restored through Google Play and verified again; creating another Daily 10 account does not automatically grant access.

Information in your request

We use the email address and information you provide to identify the request, verify ownership where needed, and respond. Email requests pass through your and our email providers. Send only the information needed to handle your request.

Read the Daily 10 Privacy Policy for more about the app's data handling.
